newsitem.title: USA: Zomax Optical hopes to ease margin pressure.
newsitem.headline: Zomax Optical hopes to ease margin pressure.

text.p: Zomax Optical Media Inc said it hopes to offset current margin pressures with higher sales and lower costs in the second half of fiscal 1997.
On Monday, the company reported net income of $278,350, or $0.06 a share, in the first quarter ended March 28, versus $186,842, or $0.07, in the same period a year ago.
Zomax Optical had 4.4 million common shares outstanding in the most recent quarter, versus 2.8 million in 1996.
Sales improved to $5.4 million from pro forma sales of $3.8 million, which reflect the operations data of the predecessor partnership, the company said.

Zomax Optical also said its recently acquired Benchmark Media Services Inc software replication business should contribute to its sales in the second quarter and Benchmark's earnings should be accretive by the end of the fiscal year.
Zomax Optical offers multimedia replication services.
Its shares were up 1/4 Tuesday at 5-1/2.
